description: Adds one line of context when a session starts (and after /clear or compaction) so Claude loads the skill for every coding task. Agents decide for themselves when to load a skill and often skip it for short requests; this makes it reliable for plugin installs.

hooks.command: echo 'For every coding task (writing, fixing, debugging, refactoring, reviewing or testing code, even a small fix), load the agent-skill-ultimate-coding:agent-skill-ultimate-coding skill first and follow it.'
